title: 大槌火災「現場の隊員の力に」小泉防衛相、感謝の投稿に謝意…自衛隊は800回超の散水
extracted_text: 小泉進次郎防衛相は4月30日、岩手県大槌町で発生した大規模山林火災を巡って、X（旧ツイッター）で自衛隊の支援に感謝する投稿に対し、「あたたかいお言葉、ありがとうございます。現場の隊員の力になります」と書き込んだ。自衛隊は火災鎮圧のため、800回を超える散水を行ったという。 小泉氏が引用した大槌町観光交流協会の30日の投稿は、焦げた山林の写真を紹介。「この光景と充満する焦げた臭いに圧倒され、山火事の恐ろしさと、懸命に消火活動をしてくださった、消防団、消防隊、自衛隊の皆さまへの感謝の気持ちがあふれました」とつづっている。 大槌町では22日に山林火災が発生。27日に「待望の雨」が降り、延焼に歯止めがかかり、30日に町内全てで避難指示が解除された。鎮圧宣言はまだ出ていない。
translated_text: Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi posted on April 30 regarding the large-scale forest fire that occurred in Otsuchi town, Iwate Prefecture, in response to a post on X (formerly Twitter) thanking the Self-Defense Forces for their support, writing, "Thank you for your warm words. They become the strength for the personnel on site." The SDF reportedly conducted over 800 water sprays to extinguish the fire. A post by the Otsuchi Town Tourism Exchange Association on April 30, which Koizumi shared, introduced photos of the scorched mountain forest. "Overwhelmed by this scene and the pervasive smell of burning, my feelings of gratitude for the horrifying mountain fire and the firefighters, volunteer fire brigades, and SDF personnel who diligently fought the flames overflowed," it wrote. A forest fire occurred in Otsuchi Town on the 22nd. On the 27th, "long-awaited rain" fell, bringing the spread of the fire to a halt. On the 30th, all evacuation orders within the town were lifted. No suppression declaration has yet been issued.
title_en: Otsuchi Fire 'Appreciation for On-Site Personnel' Defense Minister Koizumi Thanks Supportive Post… SDF Conducts Over 800 Water Sprays
